{{Video games}}
This is a list of the best selling video games for the [[Nintendo Switch]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. As [[Nintendo]] shares the sales of their video games every quarter while most other publishers do not share sales figures per console, this list consists mostly of Nintendo-published titles.

Nintendo Switch, a hybrid home console and handheld device, launched worldwide on March 3, 2017. By the end of 2017, it had outsold the lifetime sales of [[Wii U]], its home console predecessor.<ref name=2017sales>{{cite web |title=The Nintendo Switch has already outsold the Wii U |url=https://www.theverge.com/2018/1/31/16954212/nintendo-switch-sales-earnings-q3-2017 |website=The Verge |date=January 31, 2018 |access-date=February 10, 2021 |archive-date=January 30, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210130200628/https://www.theverge.com/2018/1/31/16954212/nintendo-switch-sales-earnings-q3-2017 |url-status=live }}</ref> In September 2019, Nintendo launched the Nintendo Switch Lite, a handheld-only version of the system. By the end of 2020, total Nintendo Switch family units had outsold the lifetime sales of the [[Nintendo 3DS]], its handheld console predecessor, by selling nearly 80 million units.<ref name=Dec2020ConsoleSales>{{cite web |title=IR Information : Financial Data – Dedicated Video Game Sales Units |url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html |website=Nintendo |access-date=November 4, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210201132918/https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html|archive-date= February 1, 2021|url-status=dead}}</ref> As of June 30, 2026, 156.59 million Nintendo Switch consoles had been shipped, with over 1.5 billion copies of games having been shipped for the platform.<ref name="ConsoleSales">{{cite web |title=IR Information : Financial Data – Dedicated Video Game Sales Units |url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html |access-date=August 6, 2026 |website=Nintendo |archive-date=August 6, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260806064641/https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The three best-selling games on the platform have been ''[[Mario Kart 8 Deluxe]]'' at 71.53 million units sold, ''[[Animal Crossing: New Horizons]]'' at 50.29 million units, and ''[[Super Smash Bros. Ultimate]]'' at 38.14 million units.<ref name="titlesales">{{cite web |title=IR Information : Financial Data – Top Selling Title Sales Units |url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/software/switch.html |access-date=August 6, 2026 |website=Nintendo |archive-date=August 6, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260806065651/https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/software/switch.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The three best-selling franchises on the platform have been ''[[Mario (franchise)|Mario]]'' at 278.84 million units sold, ''[[Pokémon (video game series)|Pokémon]]'' at 119.8 million units, and ''[[The Legend of Zelda]]'' at 75.47 million units. Other major selling franchises include ''[[Splatoon]]'', which sold 25.56 million units, and ''[[Kirby (series)|Kirby]]'', which sold 13.36 million units.
